annotations.title: List the tracked prompts and how each engine answered

description: Use this when someone asks which questions CueScout tracks for their brand, which ones the brand is missing from, or who gets named instead. Returns each tracked prompt with the latest verdict per engine (named and cited, named, or not named), the brand's mention and citation rate over the window, and the brands named instead.

brand.description: Which brand, by name or id, when the account tracks more than one. Leave empty to use the only brand; list_brands shows them all.

days.description: The window to report on, in days. Defaults to 28.
